title: Benzimidazolone pigments
text: Benzimidazolone pigments, or benzimidazolone azo pigments for short, are azo pigments named after the benzimidazolone group contained in the coupling component and are characterized by exceptional color fastness. Benzimidazolones were developed and manufactured by Hoechst and patented in 1960. They were first used as pigments in the late 1970s. Although relatively expensive, they are among the most durable organic pigments.
